title: parse() ignores a minus sign when the input has leading noise text
property: a duration written with a minus sign parses as negative, even when preceded by noise text that parse otherwise tolerates
property_test: negative sign applies with noise prefix
actual: 3600000 (sign silently dropped, because only str.trimStart()[0] === '-' is checked)
evidence: README advertises noisy input ('duration: 1h:20min' is parsed) and negatives ('-1hr 40mins' => -1*h - 40*m). The sign is detected only at the first character of the whole string (index.js line 56), so the two documented features do not combine: the number is parsed from the noisy string but its sign is lost, giving a result with the wrong sign and no error.
